blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Том съехал вниз по ___ (перила).
exercises.why: The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case: *Я иду по коридору. Они едут по дороге.* По may mean "about", "around": *Он ходит по комнате. Они ездят по городу.* Notice also: по почте — by mail; по телефону — by phone; по радио — by radio; по делу — on business. По** can also be used with the accusative case (meaning 'up to' or 'till', or, as discussed above, 'apiece'), and with the prepositional case (meaning 'after' or 'for'). **К** is relatively simpler, referring to or gesturing at the direction something is located. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 28. From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.
exercises.context: The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case: *Я иду по коридору. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 28. From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0))
